rationale: The agent canceled the order immediately without authenticating the user, without confirming the cancellation, and without attempting the user’s stated preferences in order: split payment, identify/cancel most expensive item, or switch to cheaper options. The agent also specified a cancellation reason (“ordered by mistake”) that the user did not provide. These actions violate the policy requirements to authenticate, act only on the user’s order, and confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Therefore, the conversation fails the pass bar.
